title: English Practice Quiz 0940
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: An incident report should describe what happened using ___.
questions.explanation: Incident reports should be factual, clear and objective.

questions.question: The date and time in an incident report help establish ___.
questions.explanation: Date and time details help place the event in context.

questions.question: A witness statement should contain ___.
questions.explanation: A witness should distinguish personal observations from assumptions.

questions.question: If a detail in a report is uncertain, it should be ___.
options: identified as unconfirmed rather than stated as fact
questions.explanation: Uncertainty should be made clear to avoid misleading readers.

questions.question: A corrective action in an incident report records ___.
options: steps taken or planned to address the issue
questions.explanation: Corrective actions describe how the issue is being addressed.

questions.question: A report should avoid emotional language because it can ___.
questions.explanation: Neutral wording helps keep reports factual and professional.

questions.question: An incident reference number helps staff ___.
questions.explanation: A reference number supports record tracking.

questions.question: Photographs included as evidence should be ___.
options: relevant and handled according to privacy rules
questions.explanation: Relevant evidence must also be handled appropriately.

questions.question: A follow-up entry should record ___.
questions.explanation: Follow-up records show what happened after the initial report.

questions.question: Before submitting a report, check that it is complete and ___.
questions.explanation: Reviewing accuracy and completeness improves the reliability of a report.
